    {"name": "Aleph", "url": "github.com/belluxx/aleph"}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "GitHub - Belluxx/Aleph: Give satellite imagery, terrain data, buil... | github.com/belluxx/aleph | GithubSignals | pyproject.toml Raise version to 0.2.0 2 weeks ago | README MIT license | Aleph | Download a piece of the world for you (or your LLM) | @GithubSignals | Aleph does two things: | Lets you draw a rectangle or polygon on the map and downloads everything inside it (buildings, elevation, HD satellite imagery, Street View photos, textured 3D models). | Provides any of the above information for specific points on Earth, on the fly, via the CLI. | This was born as a way to let LLMs quickly gather information from the physical world, but you can just use it to have piece of the Earth on your laptop and do whatever you want with it. | ⚠ Warning | This tool uses undocumented APIs so it may break or hit rate limits. | Capture | Street View",
  "key_claims": [
    "Aleph lets you download a textured 3D model of a landmark, including high-resolution satellite imagery and street view photos, without using an API key",
    "You draw a rectangle or polygon on a map to download everything inside it: buildings, elevation/terrain data, HD satellite imagery, Street View photos, and textured 3D models",
    "It can also provide this information for specific points on Earth on the fly via a CLI",
    "It pulls terrain data, building outlines, and Google Earth meshes directly to your computer",
    "The project was built to give AI/LLMs a direct connection to real-world geography so they can understand the physical layout of a place",
    "The tool uses undocumented APIs, so it may break or hit rate limits"
  ],
  "info_channel": "on-screen"
}
```
